description: This Java class defines a command named RetrieveFeatureDefinition used for retrieving a feature's definition from a device (thing) in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, specifying resource paths, and managing headers, and it is annotated to be immutable and JSON-parsable.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureDefinition
classes.description: A command object used to retrieve a feature's definition from a specific device (thing) in the Eclipse Ditto framework. Implements methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, resource path construction, and header management.

methods.name: RetrieveFeatureDefinition.of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of RetrieveFeatureDefinition using ThingId and feature ID.

methods.name: RetrieveFeatureDefinition.fromJson
methods.description: Static method to deserialize a RetrieveFeatureDefinition command from either a JSON string or JsonObject.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with this command.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID targeted by this command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the JSON Pointer path to the feature definition resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the command-specific payload data to a JSON object builder, respecting the schema version.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the command with updated headers.
